headline: Everpeak Metals publishes annual sustainability report
body: Everpeak Metals released its annual sustainability report covering energy use and waste reduction targets. The report was prepared in line with standard reporting guidelines.

headline: Data breach at Everpeak Metals exposes customer records
body: Everpeak Metals disclosed unauthorized access to systems holding customer records. Regulators have been notified and affected customers are being contacted.

headline: Everpeak Metals announces layoffs affecting 21% of workforce
body: Everpeak Metals said it will cut 21% of its workforce as part of a cost reduction program. Unions criticized the lack of consultation.

headline: Everpeak Metals to present at regional manufacturing conference
body: Everpeak Metals will present on supply chain practices at a regional conference in Windsor. Executives are scheduled to take questions from attendees.

headline: Everpeak Metals under fraud investigation over inflated invoices
body: Prosecutors are investigating Everpeak Metals over allegations of inflated invoicing to customers. The company denies wrongdoing, but two customers have paused orders.

headline: Everpeak Metals executives arrested in bribery probe
body: Authorities detained senior executives of Everpeak Metals as part of a bribery investigation. The board has suspended the individuals pending the outcome.
